history: Initial new CPU run: one lower-bound comparison exposed IEEE rounding (0.8119999999999999 versus 0.812); the fixture keeps the actual endpoint expression and original behavior checks.

The requested 44-file CPU batch exited 1 despite JSON success:true and 273 passing cases across 38 reported files; six collection outputs were missing. A focused supplement supplies the remaining final passing outcomes. Counts merge distinct cases and do not claim a successful whole 44-file single run.
Initial native batch on 2ee: 10 passes and 6 failures retained. The reserved GLSL parameter patch was renamed pigmentPatch without changing its arithmetic.

The intermediate ab914 focused native batch retained mobile Help overflow. Shorter copy alone did not resolve the bottom actions at 877px; the final structural layout keeps scrollable Help content above reachable Resume and End actions.

The final-source layout batch passed all four mobile cases while retaining two skin-case failures in native UI discovery, which assumed an Inspect [F] button despite the adaptive input profile. A focused two-case run uses the real keyboard KeyF and visible Tools flow where appropriate, retaining the original GPU, movement, Jet, ownership and teardown assertions.

Loaded-system runner/hash timeouts and original failure artifacts are retained. Final timeout budgets changed without deleting samples or weakening behavior assertions; no automatic retries are counted.

The clean isolated mutation disables screen-footprint filtering in a copied candidate. Exactly its intended filter behavior oracle fails (4 pass, 1 fail); the restored actual production candidate passes all 5 cases, and production files are never edited by that check. Its measured animal factory is byte-exact in the final settings-only source.
CPU and GPU bookkeeping was not wholly serial. Native batches use one GPU worker and no automatic retries.
limits: Chromium with DPR1 and software WebGL; no hardware FPS, physical-phone or WebKit claim.

The shader remains an illustrative pigment finish; its bounded hash changes the exact procedural patches. Palette coefficients, macro sampling scale, root-space attachment and geometry/animation remain protected.
The unsupported-derivative shader fallback is verified by CPU compiler checks; these native captures use supported derivative programs.
Native inspection may hide intervening rocks. Only native controls change camera position; paused camera-only ticks retain actor phases/readouts.
Raw detailed logs and the frozen source snapshot remain local ignored evidence. The committed reversal manifest reconstructs only the exact approved baseline from the matching final source.
